cases.sentence: Посмотри на Ассирию, этот ливанский ___ , с ветвями красивыми.
cases.translation: Behold the Assyrian cedar of Lebanon with beautiful branches.
cases.explain: The noun following этот (this) in descriptive predicate position takes accusative case.

cases.sentence: Был он высоким, в облака уходила его ___.
cases.translation: It was tall; its top reached into the clouds.
cases.explain: Вершина is the subject of уходила (went up), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: И вырос он выше всех деревьев в ___ , ветви его разрослись.
cases.translation: It grew taller than all the trees in the forest.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Все птицы небесные в ветвях его гнездились, все дикие звери под ветками его ___.
cases.translation: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its branches; wild animals reproduced under its boughs.
cases.explain: Verb agrees with plural subject звери (animals) in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Все великие народы жили в его ___.
cases.translation: All great nations lived in its shadow.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Кедры из Божьего сада не могли с ним соперничать. Не равнялись с ним ветвями сосны или побегами ___.
cases.translation: The cypress was not like it in branches; the pine not like its boughs.
cases.explain: Чинара as the subject of равнялись uses nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я сделал его прекрасным, с ветвями густыми, на зависть эдемским деревьям, которые в Божьем ___.
cases.translation: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of the trees in God's garden.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Так как он был высоким, вознося вершину к облакам, и возгордился высотой, я отдал его в распоряжение властелина ___.
cases.translation: Because it was high and proud, I gave it into the hand of the mightiest of nations.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession and relationship; властелина народов means ruler of nations.

reading.ru: Что сравнится с тобой величием? Посмотри на Ассирию, этот ливанский кедр, с ветвями красивыми, с кроной тенистой.
reading.question: What tree is used to compare with Pharaoh's greatness?
options: The cedar of Lebanon with beautiful branches and shadowy crown
reading.correct: The cedar of Lebanon with beautiful branches and shadowy crown
reading.explain: Pharaoh is directly compared to an Assyrian cedar of Lebanon with beautiful branches and a shady crown.

reading.ru: Был он высоким, в облака уходила его вершина. Питала его вода, подземные источники растили, текли их потоки вокруг того места, где он рос.
reading.question: How did the tree grow so tall and prosperous?
options: Water and underground springs nourished it with streams flowing around its location
It was blessed by the gods
reading.correct: Water and underground springs nourished it with streams flowing around its location
reading.explain: The text explicitly describes how water and underground springs sustained the tree's growth.

reading.ru: Все птицы небесные в ветвях его гнездились, все дикие звери под ветками его плодились. Все великие народы жили в его тени.
reading.question: What lived within or around the cedar?
options: Birds nested in it, wild animals reproduced under it, and great nations lived in its shadow
reading.correct: Birds nested in it, wild animals reproduced under it, and great nations lived in its shadow
reading.explain: The passage lists the birds, animals, and nations that depended on the cedar for shelter and survival.

reading.ru: Я сделал его прекрасным, с ветвями густыми, на зависть эдемским деревьям, которые в Божьем саду.
reading.question: How did God regard this cedar?
options: He made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of the trees in Eden
He made it weak and fragile
reading.correct: He made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of the trees in Eden
reading.explain: God explicitly states He made the cedar beautiful and abundant, causing even Eden's trees to envy it.

reading.ru: Так как он был высоким, вознося вершину к облакам, и возгордился высотой, я отдал его в распоряжение властелина народов.
reading.question: Why does God give the cedar to the mighty ruler of nations?
options: Because its pride reached toward the clouds and it deserved judgment for its lawlessness
Because God wanted to reward it
Because it asked to be given away
reading.correct: Because its pride reached toward the clouds and it deserved judgment for its lawlessness
reading.explain: God judges the cedar for its arrogance and wickedness, giving it to the mightiest ruler as appropriate punishment.

reading.ru: Его ветви упали на горы и долины. Его ветки рухнули сломанными в ущелье земли. Все народы земли вышли из-под его тени и оставили его.
reading.question: What happened to the cedar after it was given to the mighty ruler?
options: Its branches fell on mountains, its boughs were broken in valleys, and all nations abandoned it
It flourished in a new place
reading.correct: Its branches fell on mountains, its boughs were broken in valleys, and all nations abandoned it
reading.explain: The passage describes the cedar's complete destruction—branches falling, boughs breaking, and all nations forsaking its shadow.
